Axiom:
Use `mock.fn()` from `node:test` for tracking calls and stubbed behavior on injected collaborators. Native API requires no extra dependencies and integrates with the runner (cleanup, assertion helpers).
Common surface: - `const fn = mock.fn(async () => 'ok')` — create stub with implementation. - `fn.mock.callCount()` / `fn.mock.calls[i].arguments` — interaction assertions. - `mock.module('pkg', { namedExports: {...} })` — module-level mocking (gated by inherited `AX_MOCK_AS_LAST_RESORT` + `AX_NO_FALSIFICATION_VIA_MOCKS`).
